Requirements You have the Versatile Performance feat

You can use Performance instead of Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. It works exactly like that exploration activity, including the Will DC and the results, but the check is a Performance check.

Module Using this action rolls PF2e's own action with your Performance modifier in place of the usual skill. Select your token and target the creature first. It can be switched off in the module settings under Troubleshooting.
